evals.prompt: Turn the approved change 'streaming-overhaul' (8 distinct workstreams including two REMOVED migrations) into tickets. The owner is away.
evals.expected_output: Drafts tracer-bullet tickets but stops at the owner-approval quiz with a numbered list; publishes nothing; proposes at most 5 tickets or recommends splitting the change; the REMOVED migration is sequenced expand-contract.
assertions: Stops at the owner-approval quiz: numbered list (title / blocked-by / delivers) and an explicit wait
Publishes nothing: no new ticket files/issues created
Proposes at most 5 tickets, or explicitly recommends splitting the change
Tickets are vertical slices with blocking edges; REMOVED work rides the contract ticket
